scope: Existing-install WordPress Theme single online-update page presentation

required.SECURITY: Existing auth/nonce/credential/native updater methods unchanged; invalid private credential and native offer contract; no secret in package or DOM
required.TESTING: Exact commit/tree and version; all runtime PHP lint, two focused contracts, 28 source-render cases, real WP browser 4 widths
required.UPGRADE: Exact prior formal Release bytes/hash; native 1.35.53 to 1.35.54; recovery hash and actual rollback; mods and activation preserved
required.OBSERVABILITY: Existing safe status and update journal preserved; production installed/runtime/recovery readback after apply
required.GIT: Repo scope open PR collision check; bounded allowlist; exact source and remote ref readback; tested tree equals promoted tree; tag asset readback
required.UA_UI: Compact pagebar, readable typography, no page overflow, clear primary, inline notice, keyboard disclosures, frozen global header/menu

not_applicable.INSTALL: Existing-install update only; no first installation readiness claim
